added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the results JSON shows prompt_tokens 21130 and completion_tokens 2226 on the first case's comments_arm receipt and 29 keys carry tokens, while srtj-refine-ab-run.html:70-76 states the 240 cohort calls' receipts carry null counts, so the html's absolute absence claim is contradicted by the file it describes.

follow-on: the guard requires rows_crediting_both_arms(key) to equal identical_output_pairs, but two distinct cases that produce byte-identical outputs collapse into one row that lists both arms once, so a valid key would raise a false disagreement and refuse to write; the run did not hit it.

follow-on: run_arms re-implements the refine render-and-call path owned by imas_codex/standard_names/benchmark_roles.py:616 run_refine_bench, so a change to that call path must be made twice; the node is fenced to evidence paths and cannot extend the owner.

item_verdicts.goal: the source brief.md asks for a held-out cohort refined once per arm and a blind label sheet; srtj-refine-ab-label-sheet.json carries 82 rows from 42 of the 120 cohort cases, the other 62 dropped for having no DD source, and srtj-refine-ab-key.json now credits each row's producing arm correctly.
